english: Again… back to before the Watanagashi Festival.
//SE: higurashi cries
Rena regained her memories.\nThat must surely mark a great change.
But what was still missing… was…
(…my resolve.)
//Fade to black\n//Background: Hinamizawa (day)
Whoa, talk about the boonies!
Mmm, lovely.\nYou can tell the air itself has flavor out here.
Is something wrong, Aria?\nYou've been staring that way for a while.
…They're here.
I've been waiting.
Who are these kids???
Rena, you and Aria explain it to everyone.
Okay.
Rika, what about you?
I have a plan. Where is Shirayuki?
//Fade to black\n//Background: in front of Furude shrine (day)
Is there something… for me?
You don't remember me, Shirayuki?
I believe this is our first meeting.
I'm Furude Rika,\nshrine maiden of this very Furude shrine.
Shirayuki, please calm down\nand hear what I have to say.
//Fade to black; time passes
And so, Aria and I repeated\nthe same time over and over,\nand managed to break free of the loop.
Did my explanation make sense to you?
So you're saying that, through the power\nof Oyashiro-sama of Furude shrine,\nyou can travel back in time?
That is correct.
You go back in time when you die.\nAnd when you do, you're the only one\nwho keeps your memories - no one else remembers.
But an exception has appeared.
And that's Aria.
Aria came from the outside world,\nand after meeting me here in Hinamizawa,\nshe began to keep her memories too.
And you say that you and your club friends\nwent out to the outside world with Aria and the others,\nand traveled together…
Shirayuki - I was there, you know,\nwhen you became friends with Haruka.\nDon't you remember?
Back then…!?
I know Dokoka Town, Butei High,\nand IS Academy - all of them.
If that's true…\nwhy have I lost those memories…?
That… I don't know…
…I've understood this much.\nFor now, I'll take what you've told me\nas the truth, and ask you this.
Why did you hide this from everyone,\ntelling no one? And why have you decided\nto tell me?
Because I thought that you, Shirayuki,\nwould believe me…
There's more to the story.
More?
I've already been alive\nfor over a hundred years.
Wha…!?
I've died and gone back\nthrough this never-ending summer\nover and over again.

I used to be able to go back over a year.
That grew shorter and shorter - now a few days
is the limit. I've kept repeating the few days
right before I die.
Then… just how many times\nhave you died…?
I've stopped counting.\nI've died - been killed - so many times\nI'm sick of it. I'd given up on everything.
That's…!!
And still, it doesn't end. This summer.\nI've lived over a hundred years\nwithout ever reaching my August 25th birthday.
A secret I told no one.\nEven Aria wouldn't believe it -\nit's just too unreal.
Ngh…!
//Event art: Shirayuki's tears
Uuugh, uwaaah… aah…!!
Shirayuki…?
That's…! That's too cruel…!\nIt's too much! A hundred years! Over and over…!!
To bear such a fate all alone…!!\nThat's just - it's too cruel!!
Sick of dying…! How could you say\nsomething so sad…! Why!!
I'm sorry…
//Event art off
I'm sorry for making you\nhear such a story… Miii.
No, you've done nothing wrong!\nWhat's wrong are the ones who keep repeating this!\nI can never forgive them!
Shirayuki…
I've never felt anger\nlike this before.

But I think I understand now -
why the shrine maidens of Hoshiga
have passed their power down through the generations.
Because there are times that power is truly needed!
Nipaaa☆
…Huh?
I'm glad I told you after all, Shirayuki.
I thought you were the only one\nwho would accept this truth head-on.
But I can't say I really understand\nyour suffering, Rika-chan…
Even so, with no proof at all,\nyou believed my story.
I can at least tell whether\nsomeone's lying. And all this time,\nyou've never lied, Rika-chan…
Huh!? All this time…???
//Flash effect, sharp
Ah… wha… Rika-chan…?\nRena-chan, Mion-chan, Shion-chan,\nSatoko-chan too… I - I remember!
You remember… us?
Yeah, I remember! I really do!
Rika-chan, let's tell everyone\nwhat you told me!
But won't that just confuse them…
We'll think together and fight together!\nBecause we're friends!\nThat's what everyone told me back then, too!
Shirayuki… Understood.\nI'll try telling everyone.
It's okay - even if someone doubts you,\nI'll convince them! And I'll make them\nremember you all!
Thank you.
Nipaaa☆
Yeah!
//Fade to black\n//Background: Hinamizawa branch school
My, my. It's good that Rika-chan\nand Shirayuki-chan had their talk.
Our memories really were erased…
If we hadn't remembered, would we have had\nto repeat the same time over and over again?
Yeah. I knew we were looping, but…\nI had no idea Rika was carrying a secret like that…
Yeah. But why didn't you tell us sooner?\nWe could've done so much…!
…Perhaps it was hard to speak up,\nwondering if anyone would believe the truth.
Living with Rika all this time,\nand I couldn't do a thing for her…\nIt pains me so…!
I love you, Satoko.\nJust having you by my side makes me happy.
Rika…! I'll work harder than anyone!\nI'll do it all for you, Rika!!
Me too. Isn't that right, sis?
You don't even have to ask!\nThis Mion will smash any no-good villain\nlurking in Hinamizawa!!
Rika-chan, there's something\nI want to confirm - is that okay, I wonderr?
It's about the parasites\nand the alien invasion, isn't it.
It is true that Hinamizawa has a confirmed\nendemic disease caused by some kind of virus.
But its true nature and its effects\non the human body are still not\nclearly understood.
What about the 'Demoning Away' -\nthe kidnapping-murder cases?
The Sonozaki family really isn't involved.\nThough we do take advantage of the incidents, I guess.
Then let me ask the most important thing.\nWho is it that keeps killing Rika, over and over?
I don't know…
I don't retain my memories from right before I die,\nso I don't remember who killed me…
I see. I understand the situation, more or less.
What we need to do is simple.
Is it?
We just guard Rika-chan around the clock -\nall of us, with everything we've got.
Ooh! You're right, that IS simple!
Once you know the trick, that is.\nUntil now, nobody knew Rika-chan was being killed,\nso there was no way to stop it.
Not knowing who the enemy is or where they're hiding,\nRika alone had no way to fight back.
Besides, we already have suspects.\nWe know Riko and the Doctor Shinigami\nhave been coming and going here!
So that's how it is…!
I thought it was some complicated story,\nbut it makes a lot more sense now!
In short, we just need to protect Rika?
Then I'll make a shift schedule.\nWe'll need to take sleep in rotations, right?
Considering this may be a long battle,\nsecuring food is important too.
We should set up camp somewhere defensible.
Don't worry, Rika.\nWhoever shows up, I'll beat them senseless!
This is the perfect chance to prove\nI'm better than Dejiko!
How cheeky of Usada, nyo!\nDon't you dare look down on Dejiko's\ntrust and track record, nyo!
Did that ever exist?
In console terms, that's zero trophies, nyu.
Nyo-!?
Ahaha! Somehow…\nI've got a feeling we'll be fine.
These allies are strong indeed.
'Cause everyone's a club member.
Indeed.
(Thank you, everyone… This time,\nI'll move us forward…!)
//Battle map: forest (night)\n//Rika & Satoko are forced deployment
Cecilia here. All clear.
Rin here. All clear!
No problems on my end either.
Roger.
IS units are handy at times like this.\nThey can talk to each other directly.
No cell phones is inconvenient, huhh.
Considering the risk of wiretapping,\nphones are dangerous in this situation.
This comm thing - it's like magic, huh.
Isn't there a magic for talking\nto people far away?
Even royalty use letters.\nThat's just normal, so I never questioned it -\nbut it does sound convenient.
The Watanagashi Festival is over,\nso they should be coming soon…
//Enemy force appears. Jeanne's unit plus grunts.
Furude Rika… no, I suppose I should\ngreet everyone present.
No greetings needed, Jeanne d'Arc!
So you're the one who's been\nkilling Rika-chan!
…Who can say.
Don't play coy with me!\nWe know why you're here!
Then this will be quick. Shall we begin.
I will protect Rika-chan, no matter what!
//Battle start\n//Conversation event when Jeanne and Louise clash
You're still trying that pushy recruiting?
This time, it's more of an errand on the side.
An errand!? Even if that's true, how rude!
How convenient - your magic grows\njust from being provoked!
My magic doesn't rise from something like that!
//Conversation event when Jeanne and Aria clash
Since when did IU become such a cheap outfit\nthat does grunt work?
Someone too busy chasing Riko\ncan't see past what's in front of them.
What did you say!!
That is the limit of a mere Butei!
//Conversation event when Jeanne and Shirayuki clash
You're the one who… Rika-chan…!!
You're mistaken about one thing.\nThis is my first time meeting Furude Rika in Hinamizawa.
Prove it, then!
I don't tell worthless lies.\nBelieve me or not - that's your freedom.
//Event when Jeanne takes a certain amount of damage.
This is as far as I go.
Huh…? Already…?
(To be given such a role…)
//Jeanne disappears
Don't let your guard down yet!\nJeanne's movements are clearly off!
That was a feint. Everyone,\nstay alert for a second wave!
Sharp as ever - no opening\nto exploit, huh.
//Riko appears. From a different direction than Jeanne's initial placement
Don't you 'oh, it's you' me!
Oh, it's you.
Olmes just doesn't get jokes.
Then I'll go no-jokes mode too.
//Riko unleashes a swarm of grunts.
So this is the real attack!
We anticipated this much.\nNo need to panic.
Aww, I said no-jokes mode.\nI hate lying, y'know.
//The Doctor Shinigami and grunts appear, positioned to pincer with Riko
What!?
You pervy geezer!!
Careless, Remu.
I hadn't forgotten you were here!
(But this is bad… in an all-out battle,\nwe're definitely at a disadvantage…!)
Remu, let's move Rika-chan!\nTo where Polyal is!
Right - with this many here,\nthe other side must be thin…!
Rika-chan, we'll escort you - move out!\nHead for…
//Destination marker
Got it? Understood?
Yes.
They won't lay a finger on Rika!
//Battle resumes
You're pretty chummy with that pervy geezer!
He's actually quite the charming gentleman, y'know?
Cut the crap!!
I just use what I can use, that's all!
//Conversation event when Riko and Houki clash
What's that!? That's SO cool!!
I'm telling you now - it's not happening.
Stripping girls who don't want it is the best!\nHehehe, very nice, very nicee!
An IS is not clothing!
But I think it'd suit me!\nAnd I can dual-wield properly, too!
//Conversation event when Riko and Louise clash
You never learn, do you.
Because there's something I want!\nAnd you're on my want-list, Louise -\nright on it!
Take me off it!
Nooope.
//Conversation event when the Doctor Shinigami and Remu clash
You still intend to cross blades with me\nusing such a toy?
That's my business!
You know it's futile.\nSurely you're not that foolish?
…I'd really love to chop you\ninto mincemeat, though!
Heh heh heh…!
//Conversation event when the Doctor Shinigami and Aria clash
You - I'm sending you to hell,\nnot prison!
How kind. When the time comes,\nI'll be sure to invite you to hell.
Declined! Go boil in a cauldron!
Won't you join me?
Wha-!? What are you saying!!\nPervert! Harasser! Drop dead!!
//Clear when Rika reaches the designated area
We've made it this far…!
Alright, let's shake our pursuers!
I'll take the rear guard!
Me too!
Me too!
Me toooo!!
Count me in too!
//Battle ends\n//Background: forest (night)
IS team, please take Rika-chan\nand Satoko-chan!
Roger! I'll carry them!
Please do.
I'll take Satoko!
I'm counting on you, Cecilia!
Laura and I will guard the flanks.\nHouki, please watch the rear!
Very well.
Understood!
Are you familiar, I wonder,\nwith the true art of traps…
Hm? Satoko, did you say something?
Huh?
Let's start the club activities…!
Mion?
Wait! Something's off!
Too late, I wonderr?
Rena?
There!
//Smoke bomb turns the screen pure white.
Kya! What is this!?
What is this!? Enemies!?
I'm over here…
Huh? When did you get down?
Rin! That's not her!
Hahaha, got you!
Ngh…!?
A mere smokescreen!!
Don't, Laura! It's friendly fire!
Rika! Where are you! Rika!
//The smoke clears.
Rika! Where are you! Rika!
She's nowhere to be found!
Impossible…!!
With something as primitive as a smokescreen…!
I'm sorry… I thought I saw Rika right in front of me,\nand my focus slipped for just a second… argh!\nI'm such an idiot!!
They hit the IS's weak points perfectly -\nits overpowered weaponry, and the fact that you can't feel\nsomeone riding on your back…
We can't just stand here!\nLet's find Rika!!
//Fade to black\n//Background: inside a cave
Who are you people?
No need to tell you.
At last…
I can go back…
What do you mean?
I'll just be using your power. My power.
…What do you know, I wonder?
You need know nothing.
Wha!?
You!? Why are you here!!
FAH-HAH-HAH-HAH!! It's over.
//SE: slashing kill sound
Gah!!
//Screen goes bright red\n//SE: Rika collapsing\n//Rika dies
I won't… forget…!!\nThis time… I won't forget…!
I'll carve your faces… into my soul…!\nSo next time I can tell my friends\nwho the enemy is…!!
//Fade to black\n//Background: blue sky (somewhere, not Hinamizawa)
Report. The Doctor Shinigami has killed Furude Rika.
Hweh? Why, why, why?
Unknown.
I never gave that order, right?\nWhaa-at's tha-at?! The worst!\nIs he an idiot or what?
No record of such an order exists.
Hey, K-chan, why is everyone so useless?\nWhy? How come? Give me a reason!
Because they are incomplete, it is thought.
Right. Humans are defective products, after all.\nWhether that old geezer counts as human\nis another matter.
Can't be helped, huh. Let's go take a look.
Can you have fun yet, even a little?
Playing with hostiles is not possible.
That's not what I meant!\nStudy your words a little more!
//END
